sections.overall: WOW. AEW booked the best tribute show they could, considering the tragic circumstances. It feels trite to go into detail in these ratings, considering the context but the facts are this is the highest-rated AEW (and any?) show on Cagematch of all time (9.95) with hundreds of votes coming in within the window that the ratings are calculated. Every single match rated 8+ must also be a first too. Most importantly, RIP PAC.
sections.mens: Will Ospreay vs Ricochet was one of the greatest Dynamite matches ever. It was so fitting, especially with the poignancy of Ospreay's Black Arrow to cap off an outstanding match. Not to be overlooked was Jon Moxley vs Orange Cassidy. An excellent opener for the Continental Title.
sections.womens: A great singles match between Queen Aminata and the returning Julia Hart was a highlight on Collision this week. Some decent gains for both and a well-worked match. Also, the women's Trios was an emotional, well-put together match. Marina Shafir was a highlight across the whole show. Also, a shout-out to Mercedes Mone for returning to action before being scheduled to - just another sign of how much the AEW roster cares.
sections.menstag: No standard tags this week but a few did feature in the multi-man matches.
sections.womenstag: The squash match from Divine Dominion on Collision does not count, due to it being under 5 minutes and un-rateable on Cagematch. Here's hoping to more teams and feuds ahead of this division.
sections.trios: Only one straight Trios on Collision, featuring the Death Riders' Castagnoli, Garcia & Yuta vs Gunns & Ace from the Bang Bang Gang.
